purpose: Provide deterministic translation-only single-axis locks so one world-space x or y offset can be constrained while orthogonal translation remains free, including explicit integration into the shared mixed composer, activity gate and component-isolation path.

properties.locks: bounded explicit x/y world-axis translation locks
properties.options: bounded pre/post position and velocity iteration counts

limitations: axis does not rotate with bodies
not a full prismatic or slider joint
no angular inertia, rotating anchors, angular limits or motors
component collision isolation is optional and component-wide rather than an intrinsic property of the lock
post-core projection can change positions after donor contact evidence was produced

proves: standalone axis locking, orthogonal freedom, mass sharing, kinematic following, immovable truth and replay
single-step composer integration, disabled activity filtering, component-isolation participation and deterministic replay

truth.basis: The capability remains explicitly world-axis translation only and is not relabeled as a full prismatic joint.

agency.basis: Callers choose axis, offset, activity state, solver bounds and whether component collision isolation is requested.

continuity.basis: The standalone primitive remains available while the established one-step composer/gate/isolation paths now understand it additively.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Mixed integration uses the shared composer rather than chaining standalone wrappers and accidentally advancing donor physics twice.
